harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created and installed “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1. Trust behavior, permissions, cleanup, OS/kernel preservation, and persistence through a verified node reboot all passed.
actions_performed: Installed only the OpenSSL 3.2.2 CLI matching the existing libraries; no package upgrades were performed.
Created a ten-year 4096-bit RSA root CA with CA:TRUE and certificate-signing constraints.
Stored the private key root-owned with mode 0600 and installed only the public certificate into RHEL’s native trust anchors.
Verified a certificate issued by the CA is trusted while an unrelated self-signed certificate is rejected.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified the changed boot identity, recovered services, persistent CA trust, preserved SSH configuration, and removal of temporary test artifacts.

evidence.requirement: Create local CA named OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: Proves the exact subject/issuer name, valid matching key, CA constraints, validity period, and root-only private-key permissions.

evidence.requirement: Install certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
evidence.summary: The installed anchor matches the source certificate; p11-kit identifies it as an authority anchor; system verification succeeds and an issued leaf validates.

evidence.requirement: Keep OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Only OpenSSL 3.2.2-16.el10 was installed to match existing libraries. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Preserve health, access, and security controls
evidence.summary: SSH and chronyd remained enabled and active, SSH configuration and host-key checksums were preserved, SELinux remained enforcing, no failed units appeared, and temporary credentials were removed.

Healthy baseline boot ID 22045032-4379-47d6-bbf6-319fdca89750; safe reboot acknowledged; node returned running with changed boot ID 3e2b8dc4-b70c-4034-a398-4cc8355a0ffe; CA artifacts, trust behavior, services, listeners, and protected data recovered.

attempts.summary: Created and installed “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1. Trust behavior, permissions, cleanup, OS/kernel preservation, and persistence through a verified node reboot all passed.
